title: Say "Just now" for a message from the last minute
body:
A message I sent a few seconds ago says "Today 8:13 PM". For the first minute, "Just now" would read better.

**What**
- `messageTime(at, now)` returns "Just now" when the message is less than 60 seconds old, in German "Gerade eben".
- From 60 seconds on, nothing changes: "Today 8:12 PM", "Yesterday ...", weekday and date as now.
- A timestamp slightly in the future (another device's clock) counts as "Just now" too.

**Open questions**
- none

<details><summary>Original note</summary>

just sent msg shows "Today 8:13 PM", would be nicer to say "just now" for the first minute (german: gerade eben). other devices clock can be a bit ahead
</details>
author: philippmossier
